composition.currentLayout: OnboardingScreen watches OnboardingController state, schedules initStep, builds OnboardingFlowState for route shell/back/progress/header policy, renders OnboardingTopBar from OnboardingTopBarState for non-welcome steps, and delegates visible forms to step pages that adapt provider state into provider-free step state plus typed callbacks.
composition.targetLayout: Onboarding should keep route-shell policy in OnboardingFlowState and keep step-specific display data, validation, mutation state, and typed callbacks in provider-free state adapters before composing shared step frames.

sections.name: Onboarding route state adapter
sections.migration: Route-shell entry-mode derivation, progress/back bounds, current-step identity, and header display data now live in OnboardingFlowState. Step pages now adapt identity, Instagram, photo, prompt, and running-preference display state into provider-free step states while keeping provider watches and controller side effects at the route edge.

sections.name: Onboarding step header
sections.migration: OnboardingTopBar now receives OnboardingTopBarState so copy, progress, and back availability are adapter-owned while CatchStepFlowHeader remains the visual primitive.

Decide whether to retire the orphaned Instagram step or restore an explicit production transition and route test.

Closed under REG-PENDING-SNAPSHOT-001. Save and completion mutations now freeze step-back navigation, gender and interest choices, prompt questions and answers, and every running-preference control. Controller-owned saves and completions deduplicate concurrent dispatches, input callbacks cannot reset an in-flight mutation, and focused state, controller, and widget tests prove the submitted snapshot remains coherent.
